result.description:
Rix Asset Maintenance is seeking experienced Site Supervisors to join our team in QLD, supporting a number of slope stabilization projects across the civil, mining and infrastructure sectors throughout Queensland.

Full time positions available with projects located across Queensland.

About the Role

As the Site Supervisor, you will oversee all aspects of geotechnical stabilization works including various Drilling operations, Anchor installation, Grouting, Anchor testing, Rock fall netting and catch fence installation, Steel fixing, Formwork, Concrete, Shotcrete, and Scaling.

This role requires a strong leader who can lead and manage rope access construction teams while ensuring safety, productivity, and quality standards are consistently met.

Key Responsibilities

* Supervision and coordination of rope access crews including subcontractors, suppliers, plant and equipment
* Ensure that plant, equipment, staff and subcontractors operate within safe working conditions and ensure that all operations meet the environmental, safety and legislative requirements
* Conduct pre-starts, toolbox talks, and safety briefings
* Complete daily reports, safety documentation, and permit systems
* Conduct risk assessments, pre-work safety checks and equipment inspections while ensuring compliance is within industry standards
* Oversee installation of ground support systems including rock bolts, mesh, and shotcrete preparation
* Monitor work quality and productivity of rope access teams

Required Qualifications & Experience

* IRATA Rope Access Certification (preferred)
* White card
* Driving licence
* Minimum 3 years experience in ground engineering / civil infrastructure
* Demonstrated experience supervising rope access teams
* Experience in slope stabilisation, scaling, rock bolting, or geotechnical works
* Previous mining site experience strongly preferred
* Strong knowledge of rope access safety procedures and risk management

Key Attributes

* Strong leadership and communication skills
* Safety-focused mindset
result.title: Site Supervisors

result.description:
Pressure Welder (ANZSCO 322312)
Employer: C&J Fabrications
Location: Nowra, NSW, Australia
Employment Type: Full-Time Permanent
Salary: $80,000 - $85,000

Job Ad Start Date: 10/07/26
Job Ad Finish Date: 09/08/26

About the Role:
C&J Fabrications is seeking a qualified and experienced Pressure Welder to join our fabrication and manufacturing operations in Australia. The successful candidate will perform high-quality pressure welding on pipes, vessels, structural components, and heavy fabrication equipment according to Australian Standards, engineering specifications, and workplace safety requirements. This role is crucial in supporting operational demands within the manufacturing and engineering sector, where suitably qualified Australian workers have not been available despite genuine recruitment efforts.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
- Perform pressure welding using MIG, TIG, FCAW, Stick, and other welding techniques.
- Weld pressure pipes, tanks, boilers, and structural steel components.
- Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and welding procedures.
- Operate welding equipment and fabrication machinery safely and efficiently.
- Conduct weld preparation, grinding, gouging, cutting, and finishing.
- Inspect completed welds for structural integrity and quality compliance.
- Perform welding in accordance with AS/NZS welding standards and site specifications.
- Maintain workshop safety and comply with WHS requirements.
- Complete fabrication and repair work within project deadlines.
- Participate in shutdowns, maintenance projects, and site installations as required.

Minimum Requirements:

Qualifications:
- Relevant Trade Qualification equivalent to:
- Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade, or
- A recognized international welding trade qualification.
- Welding certifications are advantageous.

Experience:
- Minimum of 3 years of post-trade experience as a Pressure Welder.
- Experience in heavy fabrication, manufacturing, mining, oil & gas, or industrial environments is preferred.

Skills:
- Strong knowledge of pressure welding techniques.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
- Experience welding carbon steel, stainless steel, and alloy materials.
